narrative.details: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ahh, water blessed by Hervdana herself, and gathered by your own hands? A gift indeed.These vials shall birth your sapta, letting you glimpse the water spirits at Stendel's Pond, near Moonbrook. The last few drops of the water have an equally important purpose... waste not even a cork stopper dampened with sacred water.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello again, Theinn. Yer looking well.What brings you back to me so soon?
